box.annotation: Adjusts the chance that each step has to trigger a note. When set to minimum, a step will never play back a note. When set to maximum, it will always trigger a note.
box.name: Fader Chance.maxpat

box.annotation: Adjusts the MIDI Velocity on a per step basis.
box.name: Fader Velocity.maxpat

box.annotation: Adjusts the MIDI Note length on a per step basis.
box.name: Fader Length.maxpat

box.annotation: Adjusts the MIDI pitch interval on a per step basis. There are 7 intervals available, which are defined via the Scale drop down menu.
box.name: Fader Transpose.maxpat

box.annotation: Adjusts the MIDI pitch octave on a per step basis. Values go from -3 to +3 octaves.
box.name: Fader Octave.maxpat

box.annotation: Can be used to shift the sequencer's root note. If "MIDI" is active, this control is disabled, because the root note is then defined via incoming MIDI messages.
These buttons control all steps in the respective timeline, allowing to randomize steps compeltely, randomize steps only partially, and resetting the steps to a predefined default value.
